_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics and flat funding/F&G mid-range favor holding the current rung rather than forcing a break; Disbelief is the only legal -1 step if the divergences persist without a range break.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency coil; narrative supplies no forward phase and leans flow-bullish, so split on tone
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 47-54 with funding near flat and 30d momentum mid-50s without range break
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks above 62 with 30d momentum above 70 and funding heating, or drops below 46 on VIX spike and negative funding
